g.text: Decision D2 · Where does docs sync and adapter conformance run: inside the 1 deployable or as its own job binary?
decision-organise-D2 · generated from organise.json · confidence medium · open

svg.text: Rationale: Recommendation A: it keeps the fixed target of 1 deployable and lets fleetd react to a CLI version change. The strongest argument against A: the design says to generalise crates/herdr-docs-sync, which is its own binary today, and B follows
that text. The design does not say whether the widened tool ships in the horch binary, so the operator decides.
Would flip if: The operator wants docs sync to run when fleetd is down
Would flip if: The docs fetch needs network access that the daemon must not have

g.text: Option A
A horch subcommand inside the 1 deployable that
fleetd schedules daily and on a CLI version change.
Recommended.
+ Keeps the 1-1 scale target and 1 release asset
+ fleetd sees a CLI version change first and can start the run
at once (FM-19)
+ A drift becomes a task through the only ledger writer
− Moves crates/herdr-docs-sync code into the horch binary
− The horch binary gets the docs fetch and mirror code
! A slow docs fetch runs inside the daemon and delays the
reconcile pass, unless it runs as its own process role
Option A
decision D2 option A, derived from the organise teams and deployables

Option B
A separate agent-docs-sync job binary, widened from crates/herdr-docs-sync as design Docs sync says, run on a
schedule.
+ Follows the design text: generalise crates/herdr-docs-sync into agent-docs-sync
+ The daemon never runs network fetches for docs
− A second deployable breaks the 1-1 scale target
− A second release asset and a second scheduler entry on 3 OSes
! The job and the daemon disagree on the profile health format after an update
Option B

Option C
A development tool in the repository
only; the conformance results ship
inside each horch release.
+ No runtime code on the user's machine for docs
sync
− A CLI update between 2 horch releases is not
caught before dispatch, which FM-19 requires
− Contradicts design: Docs sync runs daily and
on any CLI version change
! Every worker of an updated CLI fails until the
next horch release (FM-19)
